description: List every quiz row in a course, including the New Quiz stub Canvas mixes into the same list (quiz_type: quizzes.next, with no question or submission detail of its own). Use quiz_type to tell Classic Quizzes (assignment, practice_quiz, graded_survey, survey) apart from New Quizzes, and list_new_quiz_items for a New Quiz's actual questions. Returns each quiz's title, quiz_type, points_possible, question_count, due_at and published state. Use get_quiz to fetch one quiz by ID, list_quiz_questions for its fixed questions, and list_quiz_submissions for student attempts. Fetches every page (100 per request) and fails with a 'Results are incomplete' error instead of silently truncating.
name: list_quizzes
title: List Quizzes
